<div class="parsedown-markdown"><h2 id="54835383_活动流程">活动流程</h2>
<p>推荐通过微信或者QQ打开；可双渠道白嫖</p>
<p><img src="https://s3.bmp.ovh/2026/02/22/o1dLNNYf.png" alt="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<ul>
<li>访问 腾讯先锋-云游戏 <a rel="nofollow noopener" href="https://m.gamer.qq.com/v2/game/vpvbb8tb9a2hkbmm?sid=NczgaczAInLqLIbA&amp;game_login_status=logined" target="_blank">活动地址</a> 登录进入游戏(不需要进行后续)并记下所登录的区服(如QQ|微信-XXX&lt;服名&gt;)</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://s3.bmp.ovh/2026/02/22/JPFkHALv.png" alt="" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></p>
<ul>
<li>访问 QQ音乐活动地址 <a rel="nofollow noopener" href="https://y.qq.com/forest/pzzW-hu3fjcVGJYb/index.html?adtag=hz_yx_mfzq_yxzj&amp;_miniplayer=1&amp;share_origin_id=e5554b48-af76-42e1-83a9-43368341d913&amp;share_session_id=ee81cb40-8175-4d79-a46c-fd073204041d&amp;hosteuin=ow65ownzoKEiNn**&amp;qq_aio_chat_type=3&amp;ADTAG=wxfshare" target="_blank">活动地址</a></li>
</ul>

<ul>
